name: Example tenant hygiene
description: Generic, widely published Microsoft 365 settings across the admin centres. An example to copy from, not a recommendation for any particular organisation.

checks.title: Users can register applications
checks.why: Registering an application creates an identity that can be granted access; it is an administrative decision.

checks.title: Users can create security groups
checks.why: Security groups are used to grant access, so who creates them should be deliberate.

checks.title: Guest invite restrictions
checks.location: Identity › External Identities › External collaboration settings

labels.\"everyone\": Anyone in the organization can invite guest users
labels.\"adminsGuestInvitersAndAllMembers\": Member users and users assigned to specific admin roles can invite
labels.\"adminsAndGuestInviters\": Only users assigned to specific admin roles can invite guest users
labels.\"none\": No one in the organization can invite guest users

checks.why: Invitations bring outside accounts into the directory.

checks.title: Guest user access restrictions
checks.location: Identity › External Identities › External collaboration settings

labels.\"a0b1b346-4d3e-4e8b-98f8-753987be4970\": Guest users have the same access as members
labels.\"10dae51f-b6af-4016-8d66-8c2a99b929b3\": Guest users have limited access to properties and memberships of directory objects
labels.\"2af84b1e-32c8-42b7-82bc-daa82404023b\": Guest user access is restricted to properties and memberships of their own directory objects

checks.why: Guests should not be able to enumerate the directory.

checks.title: Security defaults
checks.location: Identity › Overview › Properties › Manage security defaults
checks.why: Security defaults and Conditional Access are alternatives; which one is expected depends on licensing.

checks.title: Conditional Access policies that are on
checks.why: Policies in report-only or off state enforce nothing.

checks.title: Days before passwords expire
checks.location: Settings › Org settings › Security & privacy › Password expiration policy
checks.why: Current guidance is that passwords should not expire on a schedule.

checks.title: Mark devices with no compliance policy assigned as
checks.why: A device nobody has assessed should not count as compliant.

checks.title: Compliance status validity period (days)
checks.why: A device that stops checking in should lose its compliant status in good time.

checks.title: Device compliance policies
checks.why: Conditional Access can only require compliant devices if compliance is defined.

checks.title: Mailbox auditing on by default
checks.why: Mailbox audit records are how access to a mailbox is reconstructed afterwards.

checks.title: Modern authentication for Outlook
checks.location: Settings › Org settings › Services › Modern authentication
checks.why: Basic authentication cannot be protected by multifactor authentication.

checks.title: Turn off SMTP AUTH protocol for your organization
checks.why: Authenticated SMTP submission uses basic authentication; turn it on only for the mailboxes that need it.

checks.title: External sender identification in Outlook
checks.why: Marking external mail helps people notice impersonation.

checks.title: Enable the common attachments filter
checks.location: Email & collaboration › Policies & rules › Threat policies › Anti-malware › Default (Default)
checks.why: Executable and script attachments are a common way in.

checks.title: Enable zero-hour auto purge for malware
checks.location: Email & collaboration › Policies & rules › Threat policies › Anti-malware › Default (Default)
checks.why: Mail found to be malicious after delivery should be removed.

checks.title: Enable mailbox intelligence
checks.location: Email & collaboration › Policies & rules › Threat policies › Anti-phishing › Office365 AntiPhish Default (Default)
checks.why: Knowing who people usually correspond with makes impersonation easier to spot.

checks.title: Automatic forwarding rules
checks.location: Email & collaboration › Policies & rules › Threat policies › Anti-spam › Anti-spam outbound policy (Default)
checks.why: Automatic forwarding to outside addresses is a common way data leaves after an account is compromised.

checks.title: Record user and admin activity
checks.why: Without the unified audit log there is no record to investigate from.

checks.title: Data loss prevention policies that are on
checks.why: Policies in simulation or off state enforce nothing.
